components.name: Primary Consultation Button
components.description: The red action for consultation starts and form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: .8rem 1.2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--red); color: #fff; font: 800 .78rem/1.1 var(--condensed); letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .22s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .22s var(--ease-out), background .22s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #be2017; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Header Consultation Button
components.description: The compact black action anchored in the white desktop header.
components.css: .ds-btn-header { padding: .78rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--black); color: #fff; font: 800 .78rem/1.1 var(--condensed); letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-header:hover { background: var(--red); } .ds-btn-header:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Selected Service Path
components.description: The large binary choice that separates concrete and landscape intent.
components.css: .ds-service-choice { position: relative; min-height: 130px; width: 100%; padding: 1.6rem 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--black); color: #fff; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-service-choice::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 -4px; height: 4px; background: var(--red); } .ds-service-choice strong { display: block; font: 400 clamp(2rem,4vw,4rem)/1 var(--display); } .ds-service-choice span { font: 700 .78rem/1.1 var(--condensed); letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-service-choice:hover::after { height: 8px; } .ds-service-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Consultation Field
components.description: A square plan-field input for project details.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">PROJECT LOCATION<input class="ds-field" placeholder="Street, city, or neighborhood"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; color: var(--black); font: 800 .78rem/1.1 var(--condensed); letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: .42rem; padding: .88rem .9rem; border: 1px solid #9b9da1; border-radius: 0; background: #fff; color: var(--black); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--body); text-transform: none; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--black); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--red); outline: 3px solid rgba(224,43,32,.15); }

components.name: Indexed Service Panel
components.description: A square service surface with a red vertical index rail and plan-paper content.
components.html:
C

BUILD THE SURFACE THE SITE CALLS FOR.

Concrete considered as part of the surrounding property.
components.css: .ds-service-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 66px 1fr; min-height: 220px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--black); } .ds-service-index { display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--red); color: #fff; font: 400 3rem/1 var(--display); writing-mode: vertical-rl; } .ds-service-panel div { padding: 2rem; } .ds-service-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 .8rem; font: 700 2rem/1 var(--condensed); } .ds-service-panel p { color: var(--steel-dark); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--body); } .ds-service-panel:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mobile Contact Bar
components.description: Two equal actions that keep phone and consultation paths reachable on mobile.
components.html: CALLFREE CONSULTATION
components.css: .ds-mobile-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; min-height: 66px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 -10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.22); } .ds-mobile-actions a { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: .75rem; color: var(--black); font: 800 .78rem/1.1 var(--condensed); text-align: center; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mobile-actions a:last-child { background: var(--red); color: #fff; } .ds-mobile-actions a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-mobile-actions a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: -4px; }

narrative.overview:
This system reads like an active site plan moving toward a finished property: a white plan field, black structural blocks, metallic gray rules, and one continuous Onsite red datum. Cropped real-work photography, stamped labels, vertical indexes, and measuring marks make coordination visible without borrowing the interchangeable dark contractor template.

The voice is precise, direct, and physical. Monumental Bungee headlines establish the site, Encode Sans Condensed handles labels and workmanlike instruction, and Barlow keeps explanation readable. The red datum line is the reusable signature connecting service choice, evidence, sequence, location, and consultation.
keyCharacteristics: White and light-gray plan fields cut by black structural stages.
Onsite red used as a continuous datum, index, caption, and action signal.
Bungee display statements paired with condensed operational labels.
Cropped verified work imagery annotated with stamped site markers.
Square components, metallic rules, and a measurable mobile action path.

rules.name: The One Datum Rule
rules.body: Red should read as one continuous system of action and sequence, not as unrelated decorative accents.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bungee announces, Encode Sans Condensed directs, and Barlow explains; do not exchange those jobs casually.

rules.name: The Site Sequence Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts may rotate or stack the datum, but they must preserve the order from service fit to project proof to consultation.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use a shadow only where a surface physically lifts from the plan; rules and color fields establish ordinary hierarchy.

dos: Do use verified work photography with assertive crops and clear project captions.
Do keep red connected to action, indexing, location, and sequence.
Do preserve the vertical service rail and vertical datum sequence on mobile.
Do keep reduced-motion users in the complete final visual state.
donts: Don't replace the site-plan composition with a dark trade template or an equal rounded-card grid.
Don't use Bungee for paragraphs, form content, or small utility text.
Don't soften square controls and construction markers with generalized corner rounding.
Don't use stock imagery or decorative placeholders in place of verified Onsite project work.
